# plain_typesetting laid them out once Knuth and Plass's breaker, with
# TeX's costs, became the optimal one (2026-10-09, ADR-0021), and cells
# were measured as placed, their first margin dropped (2026-10-10), and
# blocks floating to a side were set in a column's own width (2026-10-11),
# and balancing stopped trying columns shorter than their first box
# (2026-10-11), and the room for text above its notes stopped being
# tried shorter than the text's first box (2026-10-12), and a box
# floating to the top or bottom that doesn't fit whole went to the next
# region whole rather than cut, and the notes in the floating boxes set at
# a region's top and bottom were set too, and a word wider than a line
# across several runs broke as one in a single run does (2026-10-12), and
# a box floating to the bottom that the text chosen with its notes no
# longer reaches waited for the next region, and a floating box taller
# than a region started the next region in the flow rather than waiting,
# to be cut, at its edge, and a hyphenated line ended in the soft hyphen
# where the font has it, and a word's pieces at its breaks were measured
# with the kerning between them, and a justified paragraph's last line
# set wider than its measure was shrunk to it, and a paragraph's last
# line in a region left out the space under its text, and a block's
# repeated head was kept whole and with what follows it, and a break after
# a compound's hyphen became TeX's flagged \exhyphenpenalty, and spaces

# stack).
